def fun(p):
    v=p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*eps)*TT**2 + p[2]*np.tanh(p[3]*eps) + p[4]*TT**p[5]*eps**1.5 - S
    return np.nan_to_num(v,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6)

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
eps=np.asarray(df['eps']); TT=np.asarray(df['T']); S=np.asarray(df['sigma'])
def model(p):
    return p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*eps)*TT**2 + p[2]*np.tanh(p[3]*eps) + p[4]*TT**p[5]*eps**1.5 + p[6]*eps**p[7]*TT**p[8]
def fun(p):
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        v=model(p)-S
    return np.nan_to_num(v,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6)
best=None
for trial in range(200):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(trial)
    p0=np.concatenate([rng.uniform(-3,3,6),rng.uniform(-2,3,1),rng.uniform(-2,2,1)])
    p0[1]=abs(p0[1])+0.05; p0[3]=abs(p0[3])+0.05
    lb=np.array([-100,0.001,-100,0.001,-100,-6,-100,-3,-6.]); ub=np.array([100,50,100,50,100,6,100,4,6.])
    p0=np.clip(np.concatenate([p0[:6],p0[6:7],p0[7:8],[0.0]]),lb+1e-6,ub-1e-6)
    try:
        sol=least_squares(fun,p0,bounds=(lb,ub),max_nfev=2000)
        if best is None or sol.cost<best.cost: best=sol
    except Exception: pass
print(np.round(best.x,4), np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(S))
